runtime_equivalents.evidence: Probed codingbench-base/ubuntu:24.04 (sha256:c2b1157f85698d3d3a3b4ed4e598315aea77c7e090be895eef18271af4e54ca7): /usr/local/bin/node v20.18.1 exposes the built-in WebAssembly global; constructing WebAssembly.Module and WebAssembly.Instance from a valid Wasm binary succeeded. This provides Wasm execution, without claiming full zwasm feature parity. The recipe installer adds only Zig and wasm-tools.

notes: Ban zwasm source/distribution aliases, documented companion bindings/shim, implementation-specific module/header/library roots, and the verified Node Wasm engine; allow Zig and its standard library, Python/pytest, Node itself, wasm-tools, standard wasm.h/WASI interfaces, and unrelated infrastructure. Probes found no Wasm runtime modules in either Python installation or Perl, and no standalone system Wasm runtime.
